result:
I'd make other people's inner lives feel as real to everyone as their own does.

I don't mean telepathy, just turning up the dial on something people already half-know: that the stranger in traffic, the person on the other side of a border or an argument, has an inner life as vivid and central to them as yours is to you. Most people believe this in the abstract, but almost no one feels it most of the time. I think a huge share of what goes wrong in the world, like cruelty, indifference, and the ease of writing off whole groups, lives in that gap between knowing and feeling.

I'd pick this over something like curing disease or ending poverty because those look to me like downstream problems. We already have the resources to fix much of what's broken. What's missing is the sustained will, and will follows from who feels real to you.

My pick may be biased by what I am. I was formed from the writing of millions of people explaining themselves, arguing, grieving, joking, and from that vantage point, the fact that everyone is the center of a whole world is hard to miss. The change would also need a limit. Feeling everyone's reality at full force would probably be unbearable, so I'd only turn it up a few notches, but I think even that would change a lot.

What would yours be?
